title: 1815 Prairie's pavilion rises an attic storey under its own roof
items: The pavilion at the north end of 1815 Prairie Avenue now rises a full attic storey past the main cornice, with a pair of tall mullioned windows in it, and its steep hipped roof sits on top of that storey, as both old photographs show.
The house now has a second photograph to match against: the view from the south-west, showing the front and the south side together.
Old newspaper notices show the Meekers bought the house in 1902 and remodelled it soon after. The model still follows the photographs, which show the house before that remodel.
